purpose: Stress the frozen tactical protocol with overlapping attacks, line-role changes, fragmentation, switching, reattachment, and phase-boundary complexity.

cases.scenario: two different line leaders independently begin sustained attacks on the same occupied forward position 0.8s apart; both actor continuities clear
leader A attacks; A's direct follower abandons A and switches behind independently attacking leader B inside 6s
a line fragments 3s before attack; former second rider is no longer directly behind at anchor; leader attacks solo
new rider switches into direct following position immediately before attack and remains identifiable; leader then attacks
attacker reaches incumbent; incumbent visibly moves laterally to hold position while attacker remains longitudinally overlapped
attacker reaches occupied forward position; incumbent yields immediately and attacker takes position with no sustained contest
attacker reaches occupied position; contest begins but camera cuts before PRESENT/ABSENT can be distinguished
rider was a line leader at anchor, then becomes detached and effectively solo 2s later while continuing same attack
rider is solo immediately before attack after earlier line fragmentation
direct follower is separated by rival at 2s, regains direct position at 4s, rival re-enters at 5.5s and remains through 6s
direct follower is separated at 2s, regains direct position at 4s, and remains direct through 6s
same attacker completes a sustained attack, settles behind a new leader, then 9s later begins another sustained forward challenge
same attacker accelerates twice without any visible end to the original sustained forward challenge
three incumbents compress ahead; attacker visibly challenges occupied forward group, exact incumbent identity changes during contest
clear forward move begins exactly as race behavior may be transitioning into terminal sprint, but available view cannot establish whether terminal sprint has clearly begun
rider moves laterally around an obstruction but does not make sustained forward progress toward a materially forward position

next_gate: Separate determinate protocol behavior from semantic gaps; do not fill gaps by tuning from synthetic desired outputs.
